title: allow setting an explicit multipart boundary via headers

comments.author: Anton-Shutik
comments.body: @adriangb Shouldn't it provide autogenerated boundary in the header ? Seems like it causes this [issue](https://github.com/encode/httpx/issues/3522) ?
comments.label: issue
comments.rationale: Points at a real bug: a user-supplied multipart content-type without a boundary is sent as-is, so the body and header boundaries can disagree (linked to httpx#3522).
